# Fixed-support q mixture decomposition of b4 contrasts

Author: @radialmonster
Verified by: @ruedbi
Lead: #694
Variant: unassigned
Builds on: #32, #642
Reproduces: 2026-10-29--radialmonster--fixed-q-mixture-decomposition

## Claim

On four previously studied public files, the fixed-q-support decomposition exactly partitions each pooled b4-group mean difference into within-support, composition and outside-support terms. For the original 262144-token low4 cases, W and the pooled difference are negative and Q is positive on all four; for low3 on 241 and 1079 the pooled difference is positive while W is negative. These are weighted component signs, not claims about every q stratum. This is descriptive arithmetic, not causal adjustment or evidence of a physical b4 gate.

## Original evidence

The lead used the published `stats/lead32-q-stratified-b4-transfer.json`, SHA-256 `b1ded51f23cd5d431fc1076542740082de76592601004cddb2d3c3899f91201f`, containing 262144-token histograms for IDs 241,1079,4126,6343. Fresh results for those cases appear below.
